# Meeting AI Analyser

> Meeting AI Analyser is a Windows desktop application that acts as a live AI co-pilot during any meeting. It transcribes audio locally with OpenAI's Whisper model and uses Claude AI (via the Claude Code CLI) to deliver real-time summaries, translations, explanations of jargon, and structured action items. No bot joins the meeting; audio never leaves the user's PC.

## Key facts

- **Name**: Meeting AI Analyser (also written "Meeting AI Analyzer", "MeetingAIAnalyser")
- **Website**: https://www.meeting-ai-analyser.com/

- **Author**: Nicolas SAGE
- **License**: Open source (code auditable on GitHub)
- **Current version**: 1.0.2

## What it does

Meeting AI Analyser captures system audio and microphone input from any application playing audio on Windows (Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, Webex, Discord, Slack huddles, browser tabs, in-person meetings recorded by mic). It runs OpenAI's Whisper model locally to produce a real-time transcript in 90+ languages, then sends only the text transcript to Claude AI to generate structured summaries every 60 seconds — decisions, action items, key takeaways — plus on-demand explanations of jargon and live translation into the user's preferred language. A new "Conversation Memory" feature lets users resume past Claude sessions to build context across recurring meetings.

## Who it's for

- Non-native speakers joining meetings in a foreign language
- People in technical, legal, medical, or financial meetings outside their expertise
- Developers and tech leads capturing decisions and tickets
- Managers and product owners needing clean meeting summaries
- Consultants and salespeople staying present with clients
- Students and researchers turning lectures and interviews into structured notes

## How it compares to alternatives

Unlike Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, Tactiq, and tl;dv:
- **Local transcription** (Whisper runs on the user's machine; audio is never uploaded)
- **No bot joins the call** (capture is via Windows WASAPI on the user's own PC)
- **One-time €29 purchase** instead of $12–$25/month subscription
- **Open source** (code on GitHub for audit)
- **AI conversation memory** across past meetings

## Requirements

- Windows 10 or Windows 11
- ~4 GB RAM free for Whisper (smaller models run on lower-spec machines)
- Modern multi-core CPU (GPU optional, accelerates larger Whisper models)
- For AI analysis: [Claude Code CLI](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code) installed + an active Claude subscription (Pro, Team, or Enterprise). Transcription alone works without these. Analysis cost is covered by the user's Claude subscription — no per-minute fees.
